title: Self-supervised biomedical signal representation learning from intrapartum cardiotocography for neonatal risk enrichment
description: Code, manuscript source files, Frontiers official LaTeX submission package, figure source data, supplementary tables and reproducibility files for an open-data biomedical signal representation-learning study of self-supervised cardiotocography trajectories, calibrated neonatal risk enrichment and domain-shift assessment.
